hook: Change one neuron, and this AI becomes a pirate.
hookText: One neuron turns this AI into a pirate

beats.say: Fermion Research mapped every neuron in Qwen3 8B. Nudge neuron 7,601 in layer 9, and the model starts talking like a pirate. No prompt, no fine-tuning.
They estimate about 5,000 real switches like this, roughly one neuron in a hundred, for language, persona and tone.
And whenever the model reasons, through maths, code or a plan, the same group of about 140 neurons lights up.
